patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Jira only if your buying job matches “Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo ” rather than Motion's shape. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Jira's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Jira is shaped for Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard  whereas Motion is shaped for AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Jira is Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo annual.; Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Jira (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Motion (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Jira — Steep learning curve outside engineering; Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors.

Limitations — Jira: Steep learning curve outside engineering; Confluence often required for wiki/docs depth; Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO.

Poor-fit cases: Jira is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Steep learning curve outside engineering · Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Avoid Jira if you actually need Motion's motion (AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
